info.description: ## Overview **Waseel APIs v4.0** — an executable Postman collection covering: 1. **CCHI Inquiry** 2. **Eligibility** 3. **Pre-Authorization** (request, search, communication, cancel) 4. **Claims Upload** (upload, upload summary, extraction name check) --- ## Base URL Staging URL: - `stg-eclaims.waseel.com` Production URL: - `eclaims.waseel.com` --- ## Authentication ### Collection auth (Bearer token) This collection is configured with **Bearer Token** auth at the collection level. ``` http Authorization: Bearer {{token}} ``` > Note: a couple of requests also include an explicit `Authorization` header. Prefer using the **collection-level auth** to avoid duplication and casing mismatches. ### Obtain token Run [0 - Authentication](https://request/47120593-04039381-fe0c-4115-9b3b-2cebbeb8455e) first. That request saves the access token to the active environment variable: - `token` --- ## Environment variables (Staging) The **Staging** environment (UID `47120593-1d6f8f17-33a1-41a1-b6d8-72568bfc00c5`) defines the variables below. Use placeholder/example values only (don’t commit real secrets into docs). | Variable key | Purpose / what it is | Where it is used | Example placeholder value | Mark sensitive? | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `baseUrl` | Hostname (and optional domain) used to build the request URLs for Waseel endpoints. | **Request URL** (e.g., `https://api.{{baseUrl}}/...` and `https://{{baseUrl}}/...`) | `stg-eclaims.waseel.com` | No | | `username` | API username used to obtain an OAuth access token. | **Request body** for authentication (the [0 - Authentication](https://request/47120593-04039381-fe0c-4115-9b3b-2cebbeb8455e) request). | `your-stg-username` | Yes | | `password` | Password for the API username used during authentication. | **Request body** for authentication (the [0 - Authentication](https://request/47120593-04039381-fe0c-4115-9b3b-2cebbeb8455e) request). | `your-stg-password` | Yes | | `providerID` | Waseel Provider identifier (tenant/context) used in many endpoint paths. | **Request URL path** (e.g., `/providers/{{providerID}}/...`) across multiple requests. | `706` | No | | `nphiesID` | NPHIES identifier used by NPHIES-related workflows (e.g., correlating or identifying an entity within the NPHIES domain). | Typically **request body** and/or **request URL** depending on the specific NPHIES endpoint used in this collection. | `10000000003170` | No | | `documentID` | Patient document / national ID (used as `patientKey`) for CCHI inquiry. | **Request URL path** in [1 - CCHI Inquiry](https://request/47120593-d768d775-f616-4c15-b736-68948cb54369) (e.g., `/patientKey/{{documentID}}/...`). | `1000000000` | Yes | | `token` | OAuth access token used for Bearer authentication. | **Authorization header** via collection auth: `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`. Set by the [0 - Authentication](https://request/47120593-04039381-fe0c-4115-9b3b-2cebbeb8455e) request. | `eyJhbGciOi......` | Yes | --- ## Quick start (recommended order) 1. [0 - Authentication](https://request/47120593-04039381-fe0c-4115-9b3b-2cebbeb8455e) 2. [1 - CCHI Inquiry](https://request/47120593-d768d775-f616-4c15-b736-68948cb54369) 3. [2 - Eligbility Request](https://request/47120593-68248780-27e1-408c-af28-e900a8efc6fc) 4. **Pre-Auth**: [3 - Pre Authorization Request](https://request/47120593-b3e9a8de-232e-44e0-843f-0233b1b74fcf) then optionally [3.1](https://request/47120593-39911e77-840d-4e20-8092-bdf9e368f478) / [3.2](https://request/47120593-476d64a7-5996-41dd-a783-30b5ade54e48) / [3.3](https://request/47120593-d07b1edb-7c2c-46b9-b2e8-7cc4506d40ac) 5. **Claims**: [4 - Claims Upload](https://request/47120593-9d53ea5c-863c-4f6e-bae5-d4f5aa240b2b) then [4.1](https://request/47120593-2e8cf7a2-0965-40cb-81d7-80555350292f) and [4.2](https://request/47120593-72f8e79f-5cbb-481d-9ba0-b31d59e3e439) --- ## Common errors Typical error categories you may encounter: - **401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden**: missing/expired `token` or invalid credentials - **400 Bad Request**: validation errors (missing required IDs/fields) - **404 Not Found**: invalid `providerID` / `patientID` / `uploadID` / `RequestID` - **5xx**: server-side issues; retry later or contact Waseel support --- ## Rate limits No explicit rate-limit information is included in this collection. If your integration has contractual limits, document them here later. --- ## Examples (Documentation & Mocks) For richer documentation (and to support mock servers), save at least one **Example** per request (success + common error cases). If examples are missing, create them by sending the request in a safe environment or by importing known sample responses.
